mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM sys_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{tenantVersion} FOR SHARE
SELECT config_id FROM sys_im_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND config_id = #{configId} AND version = #{configVersion} FOR SHARE
SELECT mapping_id FROM sys_im_user_mapping WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mapping_id = #{bindingId} AND version = #{bindingVersion} AND user_id = #{userId} AND config_id = #{configId} FOR SHARE
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{userVersion} FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM sys_user_blacklist WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR SHARE

SELECT history.history_id FROM wf_task_history history JOIN sys_im_callback_event event ON event.tenant_id = history.tenant_id AND event.callback_id = #{callbackId} JOIN sys_im_todo_mapping todo ON todo.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND todo.mapping_id = event.task_mapping_id AND todo.config_id = event.config_id AND todo.im_type = 'WECOM' WHERE history.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND history.history_id = SHA2(CONCAT('wecom-callback', CHAR(10), #{tenantId}, CHAR(10), #{callbackId}), 256) AND history.task_id = todo.task_id AND history.operator_id = todo.receiver_user_id AND CAST(todo.im_user_id AS BINARY) = CAST(event.im_user_id AS BINARY) AND event.action_type IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT') AND history.action IN (event.action_type, CONCAT('COUNTERSIGN_', event.action_type))
